title: 工事用伸縮照明トレーラー
description: 小型の牽引式照明設備。4基の非発光灯具、伸長状態の角形マスト、手動巻上げ部、板ばね付き車軸、牽引金具と4本の接地アウトリガーを造形。牽引車、可動部、発電・照明・牽引機能は含みません。安全認証や積載性能を表すものではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.180 × 4.188 × 2.500 m、28,620三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A compact towable lighting prop with four unlit lamp housings, a statically raised telescopic mast, hand winch, leaf-sprung axle, coupling and four deployed stabilizers. No towing vehicle, moving parts, power generation, illumination or towing function is included. It makes no safety-certification or load-capacity claim. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.180 × 4.188 × 2.500 m; 28,620 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
